annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委 (National Health Commission of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets a 3-year cycle (to 2035) for naming national fertility-friendly cities and employers, with caps on numbers per cycle.
Procedure: voluntary application, provincial recommendation, expert review, public notice, formal naming.
Titles are valid for 3 years and subject to re-review; they are revoked if re-review fails or serious problems arise.
Bans fees for applicants and requires reducing the burden on grassroots units.
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's National Health Commission issuing measures for creating and managing national fertility-friendly cities and employers. It sets application, review, naming, re-review and revocation procedures. It has nothing to do with AI or robotics.

annotation.title_en: Notice of the National Health Commission on Issuing the Administrative Measures for Creating National Fertility-Friendly Cities and Fertility-Friendly Employers
